Relatively free Algebras As described in , the nilpotent quotient algorithm can also be used to determine certain relatively free algebras; that is, algebras that are free within a variety.
Computing Kurosh Algebras
determines a nilpotent table for the largest associative algebra on d generators over the field F so that every element a of the algebra satisfies a^n = 0.
suppose that T is the nilpotent table of a Kurosh algebra of exponent n defined over a prime field. This function determines polynomials describing the corresponding Kurosh algebras over all fields with the same characteristic as the prime field.
A Library of Kurosh Algebras The package contains a library of Kurosh algebras. This can be accessed as follows.
At present, the library contains the Kurosh algebras for n=2, (d,n) = (2,3), (d,n) = (3,3) and F = &QQ; or |F| \in \{2,3,4\}, (d,n) = (4,3) and F = &QQ; or |F| \in \{2,3,4\}, (d,n) = (2,4) and F = &QQ; or |F| \in \{2,3,4,9\}, (d,n) = (2,5) and F = &QQ; or |F| \in \{2,3,4,5,8,9\}.
